text:
sam: proposing we hand the adaptive-throttle runtime to eng-infra. platform keeps policy authoring + UI. infra takes execution, telemetry, and kernel/qdisc integration.
arjun: makes sense. want a minimal RPC surface so platform stays thin.
sam: minimal contract idea: Evaluate(meta) => decision {allow,defer,penalize}, Report(result), StreamEvents(selector). gRPC + mTLS.
ejulia: SLIs we care about: evaluate_p95 < 2ms, percent_deferred, penalty_ms_mean, false_positive_rate. Add alert for sudden penalty spike.
eva: operationally we need transparent penalty window params surfaced in policy so SREs can compute cost impact. expose decay_half_life and max_accumulator.
arjun: what about a local fast-path in platform to avoid hop for trivial rules? a tiny policy shim with cache could help.
sam: allowed. require policy_version fingerprint in Evaluate response so local cache invalidates on mismatch.
ops-oncall: failure modes? if infra is unreachable, what's client behavior?
sam: fail-open to a conservative grace quota, emit high-priority alert. if policy mismatch and infra down, fallback to token-bucket at <10r/s per-tenant. Documented in runbook.
ejulia: telemetry pipeline: infra will push raw penalty events into bigquery + publish to realtime topic for policy team. dashboards auto-created for canary.
arjun: security: mTLS + per-service principal, authz via team-scoped ACLs. include audit trail for Evaluate calls.
eva: canary plan: platform owns gating and rollout flags; infra owns the circuit and rollback hooks. canary steps: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 30min observation windows. rollback if penalty_rate increases > 0.8% absolute or request_success drops > 0.5%.
infra-bot: deploy-note: adaptive-throttle-handoff staged rollout scheduled. canary_rule: zone-a 5% start. auto-rollback on penalty-spike.
sam: sample policy snippet for UI: 
```
policy_version: "2026-03-01"
rules:
  - id: high_oom_tenant
    matcher: tenant_score >= 0.9
    action: penalize
    penalty:
      decay_half_life: 45s
      max_accumulator: 2000
      step_ms: 250
```
arjun: will draft protobufs for Evaluate/Report/StreamEvents and share tomorrow. include SLA note: Evaluate must succeed within 2ms p95, else caller treats as soft-fail and hits local fallback.
eva: runbook checklist from ops perspective: feature flag, canary gates, dashboards, alert runbooks, rollback lambda, postmortem template.
julia: i'll own telemetry dashboard and correlation queries (inputs -> penalty -> downstream impact).
sam: i'll author the RFC follow-up with clear boundary table and ownership. cc'ing owners for co-auth: julia, arjun, eva.
infra-bot: action-created: RFC-6167900002-adaptive-throttle-runtime-handoff assigned-> sam,julia,arjun,eva. due: 2026-03-08.
sam: thanks everyone, sync 11am tomorrow to lock APIs.
